description: Early topology and material-flow experiments include the M42 seed, with 61 vertices, 163 edges, 104 facets and equilibrium counts (2,1,1).

For the fixed AX10 seed, an exact obstruction shows that zero-centroid extensions must cross at least six original support halfspaces. A finite test excluded 65 of 66 selected six-change combinations; feasibility of the remaining combination was unresolved.
status: Exact result for a restricted family

description: Two rational constructions, C7260 with 1,213 vertices and C5368 with 897 vertices, were checked with standalone exact verifiers. Both checks reported equilibrium counts (1,1,0).

date_basis: Source date followed by verification date.
description: C1374 has 258 vertices, 687 edges and 431 facets. Source records dated 6 September were reconstructed and checked on 7 September, giving strict equilibrium counts (1,1,0).
C1370 has 258 vertices, 685 edges and 429 facets. Exact checks returned strict counts (1,1,0) and weak counts (0,0,0). Separate diagnostics examined its rounded viewing mesh.
Two exact implementations checked C752 from its integer support definition: 237 vertices, 376 edges, 141 facets, strict counts (1,1,0) and weak counts (0,0,0).
Exact verification of C746 returned 235 vertices, 373 edges, 140 facets, strict counts (1,1,0) and weak counts (0,0,0).

The rebuilt C648 R7/R12 packages each report 189 vertices, 324 edges, 137 facets, strict counts (1,1,0) and weak counts (0,0,0). Source integrity was checked, but the mathematical checks were not rerun locally.
status: AI-reported exact results; source integrity checked

description: C634_SOC and BQ13 C632 passed their supplied exact checks. C634 has 182 vertices, 317 edges and 137 facets; C632 has 180 vertices, 316 edges and 138 facets. Both have strict counts (1,1,0) and weak counts (0,0,0). Other candidates with the same complexity values are separate constructions.

The Minimum search produced exact counterexamples and finite checks for triangular-chain minors, moment constraints and a proposed four-triangle extension. These restricted results did not establish a new universal lower bound.

The C626 G8/G14 and C624 S8 source packages were checked for integrity. They include a reported exact census of one- and two-vertex deletions from the fixed S8 body. These mathematical results were not rerun locally.
status: AI-reported exact results; source integrity checked

description: C622_ROUTED was reconstructed from its finite generator. Two exact verification programs agreed on 176 vertices, 311 edges, 137 facets, strict counts (1,1,0) and weak counts (0,0,0). A third calculation confirmed the centered mass integrals. The construction and verification fixtures passed.
C622 passed a repeat verification. Separate exact checks of C64 and C80 candidates and restricted geometric obstructions produced no mono-monostatic improvement.
The Astra investigation reproduced C622 and explored support motion, persistence, contact changes, self-polar constructions and projective methods using the actual volume centroid.

Astra experiments produced rational bodies with equilibrium counts (2,1,1) and (1,2,1), alongside centroid-compensation and symmetry-preserving continuation studies. The search for a mono-monostatic body with C<500 remained open.
C622 was reconstructed again from source. Generator and verification-output hashes matched the earlier results, and the centered first moments were exactly zero.
A further reconstruction of C622 passed both exact verification programs and the third mass check, reproducing the saved output hashes.
